name: code-review/sql-injection-fanout-01
note: Four-question fan-out; 13-option choice; 5-level rubric; last noul is genuinely uncertain.

state.author: d.alvarez

introduces_vulnerability.instructions: Does this diff introduce an injection, insecure deserialization, or unhandled-input vulnerability?

criteria.true: User-controlled input reaches a query, command, or deserializer without validation or parameterization
criteria.false: Input is validated or parameterized, or the change does not touch input handling

subsystem.instructions: Which subsystem does this diff primarily modify?

criteria.database: Schema migrations, SQL queries, ORM models, transaction handling
criteria.authentication: Sessions, tokens, password handling, access control
criteria.api_handlers: HTTP routing, request parsing, response encoding
criteria.infrastructure: Deployment, containers, CI pipelines, infrastructure as code
criteria.storage: Object storage, file handling, caching layers
criteria.unclassified: Does not fit any category above

review_complexity.instructions: Rate the review effort this change needs.
criteria: Trivial: a rename or comment change with no behavioural effect
Small: a local logic change covered by existing tests
Moderate: new behaviour that needs new tests and one reviewer familiar with the area
Large: touches a shared boundary such as a database or public API and needs cross-team review
Critical: changes security-sensitive or data-integrity code and needs a security review before merge

breaks_existing_clients.instructions: Will existing API clients break because of this change?

legend.0: Trivial: a rename or comment change with no behavioural effect
legend.1: Small: a local logic change covered by existing tests
legend.2: Moderate: new behaviour that needs new tests and one reviewer familiar with the area
legend.3: Large: touches a shared boundary such as a database or public API and needs cross-team review
legend.4: Critical: changes security-sensitive or data-integrity code and needs a security review before merge
